ab91bc80 eat(map): make OffScreenDeviceArrow rotation-aware with smooth edge transitions; keep arrows visible for debugging OffScreenDeviceArrow Added mapHeading to account for current map rotation. Removed rotation guard (temporary) so arrows render even when the map is rotated. Convert device coordinate to screen point, then rotate around screenCenter by mapHeading. Replaced angle-sector edge selection with nearest ray–edge intersection (prevents edge flipping). Added corner-snapping to avoid jitter at edge transitions. Implemented symmetric spacing for multiple arrows to keep motion visually stable during rotation. Animated position/rotation changes on mapHeading updates for smoother movement. Added comprehensive doc comments describing the algorithm, rotation handling, intersection math, snapping, and spacing. Kept existing tap/press feedback behavior. Added debug prints for coordinate and placement diagnostics. iPhone/iPad Device and Group Map Views Pass mapHeading: currentMapCamera?.heading ?? 0 to OffScreenDeviceArrow. Force isMapRotated: false at all call sites to keep arrows visible during debugging. Preview Updated OffScreenDeviceArrow preview to include mapHeading. Files changed: miataru/views/Common/OffScreenDeviceArrow.swift miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_DeviceMapView.swift miataru/views/iPad/Devices Views/iPad_DeviceMapView.swift miataru/views/iPhone/Groups Views/iPhone_GroupMapView.swift miataru/views/iPad/Groups Views/iPad_GroupMapView.swift Behavioral impact: Arrows remain visible while rotating the map and move smoothly towards corners and along edges. Arrow orientation updates with heading to continue pointing towards the off-screen device.
